transcript.text: Mr. President, thank you for seeing me. I will be direct with you. I cannot rule out a deeper constitutional weakness. I must insist on further examination over the coming weeks, and I strongly recommend you reduce your working hours. I cannot yet say whether this is merely exhaustion or something more.

If you have any further suggestions or concerns, please do not hesitate to share them. I am always open to seeking new perspectives and advice. Thank you.
